meta.title: Nexport Global C.A. : International Representation and Distribution in Venezuela
meta.description: We represent and distribute international brands of agricultural, industrial, and transport equipment in the Venezuelan market.

hero.title: We represent international brands in the Venezuelan market.
hero.subtitle: Import, distribution, and business development for agricultural, industrial, and transport equipment in Venezuela.

about.title: Connecting international manufacturers with opportunities in Venezuela.
about.body: We represent international brands before Venezuelan business buyers. We build their commercial presence, manage the import and distribution of their equipment, and support their relationship with the local market across three sectors: agricultural, industrial, and transport.

point1.title: Commercial representation
point1.text: We build the presence of international manufacturers before Venezuelan buyers.

point2.title: Import and distribution
point2.text: We manage the import and distribution of equipment for the sectors we serve.

point3.title: Local market expertise
point3.text: We understand the Venezuelan business buyer and build lasting commercial relationships.

divisions.title: Three divisions. One market of opportunity.
divisions.intro: Each division serves a strategic sector of the Venezuelan market, with a specialized focus and internationally recognized equipment.

mobility.title: Nexport Mobility
mobility.text: Heavy transport, commercial trucks, and fleet solutions for businesses.

agrotech.title: Nexport Agrotech
agrotech.text: Agricultural machinery, irrigation, and technology for the field.

lineaAmarilla.title: Línea Amarilla
lineaAmarilla.text: Heavy machinery for construction and infrastructure.

howWeWork.title: Three fronts. One commercial commitment.
howWeWork.intro: This is how we manage the relationship between international manufacturers and the Venezuelan market.

step1.title: Representation
step1.text: We represent international manufacturers before the Venezuelan business buyer, building their presence in the country.

step2.title: Import and distribution
step2.text: We manage the import and distribution of equipment for the agricultural, industrial, and transport sectors.

step3.title: Commercial relationship and after-sales
step3.text: We build long-term relationships and support our clients through every stage of the commercial operation.

partnerships.title: Your next market can start in Venezuela.
partnerships.body: If you represent an international brand of agricultural, industrial, or transport equipment, Nexport offers the market knowledge and the commercial relationships needed to build your presence in the country.
partnerships.point1: Direct knowledge of the Venezuelan business buyer and their needs.
partnerships.point2: Direct commercial relationships with companies in the sectors we serve.
partnerships.point3: Backed by a business group with an operating history in Venezuela.

group.title: Backed by a group with a track record in Venezuela.
group.body: Nexport Global C.A. and Agropecuaria OuroBranco C.A. belong to the same Venezuelan business group. OuroBranco has roughly 30 years of experience in Venezuela's agribusiness sector, giving Nexport real institutional backing.
group.clarification: Nexport Global C.A. is the group's representation and distribution division. The agribusiness track record belongs to OuroBranco's operation, not to Nexport as a legal entity.

stat1.label: years of the group's track record in Venezuela

presence.title: Based in Venezuela, connected with the world.
presence.body: Nexport Global C.A. is based in Venezuela. We build commercial relationships with international manufacturers interested in the Venezuelan market; we do not operate offices or subsidiaries abroad.
